dedupeResult: The active pull-request repository search was checked separately for 4ZZZ, 2SER and Triple R, including canonical domains, submission paths and purpose-specific email routes, and returned no existing records. Each station is represented once even where multiple authorized delivery choices are available. The Australian-only 4ZZZ Album of the Week route is treated as an adjacent excluded route rather than a second opportunity.
emailVerificationLevel: music-department@4zzz.org.au was confirmed on the official 4ZZZ contact page as a follow-up address for existing submissions and is not used as the initial route. submitmusic@2ser.com was confirmed on the official 2SER contact page specifically for digital airplay consideration. music@rrr.org.au was confirmed on both Triple R's official submission and staff/contact pages as the shared station music-submission inbox. Addresses were checked for syntax, domain alignment and first-party purpose publication only; no SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level probe was performed.
safety: No email, presenter message, form or submission was sent; no track, stream, download link, WAV, MP3, artwork, biography, press pack, identity information, pre-release permission, airplay acknowledgement, consent or physical media was supplied; no JavaScript form control, CAPTCHA, honeypot, login, cookie, anti-spam or platform restriction was handled or bypassed; no payment or postage workflow was started; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
